Blou Reed blends jazz improvisation and harmony with strong, groove based rhythms to create a sound that bares the torch of tradition to light the way to the future of modern music. The band presents a wide ranging catalogue of original compositions and hip arrangements of well known Jazz standards. Blou Reed formed in 2022 when the members were still in their high school jazz programs and have been performing around Michigan ever since.

events.title: Happy Hour Dance Club: Ladies Only Dance Party!

events.title: Happy Hour: Deveaux Gauger
events.summary: Join us for a free happy hour concert! DeVeaux Gauger is a singer/songwriter from Ann Arbor, channeling the ’70’s troubadour sounds of Harry Chapin, Jim Croce & James Taylor. He blends introspective, fun, storytelling acoustic/folk/rock originals and covers played on 6 and 12 string guitars.

events.title: Happy Hour: Jaded Ravins
events.summary: Join us for a free happy hour concert! Jaded Ravins are a duo based out of a van. They play songs you never knew you needed to hear. Life, love, passion, and stories.

events.title: Happy Hour: James Cherewick
events.summary: Join us for a free happy hour concert! Jim is an artist, full stop. He's got a vibe...an energy. Jim gets up on stage and crafts the show in front of you, real time. Loops, bullhorn, pedals... I let go, and I felt it! I won't describe his sound, because, I don't believe it has a shape.

events.title: Happy Hour: Jordan Blanchard
events.summary: Join us for a free happy hour concert! Jordan Blanchard is a multi-genre multi-instrumentalist singer-songwriter with a particular affinity for roots americana (folk n' blues). He is a board certified music therapist as well as a composer for SkyRat Productions.

events.title: Happy Hour: Khalid Hanifi Quartet
events.summary: Join us for a free happy hour concert! Khalid Hanifi is an Ann Arbor, Michigan based singer, songwriter and recording artist. Over the course of three decades, leading the bands Map of the World (Atlantic Records), Kiss Me Screaming, Maypops, and now as a solo artist, he has built a deeply compelling body of work that combines uniquely thoughtful, personally and politically charged lyrical content with impeccably crafted, irresistibly infectious melodies.

events.title: Happy Hour: Kid Cooper LEvy
events.summary: Join us for a free happy hour concert! "Kid Cooper Levy is an exemplary act, sat at the wheel of a massive bus full of empty seats, waiting to take willing boarders somewhere they haven’t been before." —The Huffington Post
events.registration: Google Calendar and ICS links provided

events.title: Happy Hour: Lamm & Henley
events.summary: Lamm & Henley is an original music duo comprised of August Lamm and Andy Henley. Their music showcases tight musicianship, an inventive vocal blend, and timeless lyricism influenced by the Great American Songbook.

events.title: Happy Hour: LUVPLANET
events.summary: Join us for a free happy hour concert! Singer, Songwriter, Guitarists, Nicole Sutton and Mark McGee are the heart and fire behind Luvplanet and its musical mission! Together with undeniable chemistry they craft magnetic, feel good rock'n'roll filled with potent lyrics, lush vocal harmonies, psychedelic guitar jams and infectious optimism! Mixing Rock, Pop, Country and Blues their timeless songs ignite the hearts of the listeners. Together with drummer Michael Amos and bassist Zak Plantus, they generate a powerful presence and persuasive sound

events.title: Happy Hour: Patrick Clinton
events.summary: Join us for a free happy hour concert! Patrick Clinton wrote his first song in 1968, and after a long hiatus, he’s at it again. He’s known for offbeat, witty, often hilarious tunes about everything from frogs and chickens to cowboys, mashed potatoes, and doomed romance.

events.title: Happy Hour: Ruth Theodore
events.summary: Join us for a free happy hour concert! Starting her career as a DIY street busker, and now signed to Ani DiFranco's Righteous Babe records in the USA, distinguished British artist and ‘original folk voice’, Ruth Theodore has been steadily releasing critically acclaimed records for over a decade. An experienced stage performer, Theodore playfully pushes the boundaries of gender and genre with a sense of joyful rebellion, a touch of 1920’s vaudeville theatre and a healthy dose of punk rock attitude. Theodore delivers song after song with the relentless lyrical energy of a San-Fran beat poet, holding your attention for every second of the show.

events.title: Happy Hour: Sage Advice

events.title: Happy Hour: Save State
events.summary: Join us for a free happy hour concert! Save State is a jazz piano trio coming from the University of Michigan with a passion for video game music. The band features Daphne Titterington on bass, Kevin Payne on piano, and Cameron Payne on drums.

events.title: Happy Hour: The Bob Skon Trio
events.summary: Join us for a free happy hour concert! The Bob Skon Trio, comprised of Bob Skon on guitar and vocals, Matt Steward on percussion and vocals, and Trent Collier on bass and vocal, have been playing throughout Southeast Michigan for two decades now. With inviting vocals and skillful instrumentation, they play classic covers of the singer-songwriters of the 50’s, 60’s and 70’s as well as some masterful originals.
events.imageAlt: Happy Hour: The Bob Skon Trio

events.title: Happy Hour: The Leftovers Improv
events.summary: Join us for a free happy hour concert! The Leftovers are a Detroit-based improv comedy troupe, composed of six talented actors of a silly and unserious kind. They'll create completely new scenes and characters for your entertainment—a sitcom from scratch. Come laugh with us. Or at us. That's okay too.

events.title: Happy Hour: Tim McNary
events.summary: Join us for a free happy hour concert! Tim McNary is a world traveled, pentecostal church raised Indie Folk artist with a connective, cinematic sensibility and energy similar to artists like Ben Howard, Foy Vance, or Leif Vollebek. Accolade wise, he's had many film and tv placements, written with recognized songwriters, and toured extensively around the United States and Canada
